question: On the SrLC page for this application, which is the most recent entry with underlined (added/revised) text in Boxed Warning or sections 4, 5 or 6? Is that passage present in the S4 label version (letters and digits only, case-insensitive)?

answer.underlined_passage: Retrospective case-control studies in patients of certain Asian ancestry (e.g., Han Chinese and Thai) suggest that the HLA-B*1502 allele is associated with an increased risk (approximately 2-3 times higher) of developing Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS)/toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN) in patients using lamotrigine. The risks and benefits of therapy should be weighed when considering use of LAMICTAL in patients known to be positive for HLA-B*1502. Application of HLA genotyping as a screening tool has important limitations and must never substitute for appropriate clinical vigilance and patient management. Many HLA?B*1502?positive patients treated with LAMICTAL will not develop SJS/TEN or other hypersensitivity reactions, and these reactions can still occur in HLA?B*1502?negative patients of any ethnicity
